name: optimize_java_fib_memoized_recursion
description: Optimizes an exponential-time naive recursive Fibonacci to O(n) using memoization
prompts: Fib.of(long n) in Fib.java computes the n-th Fibonacci number (of(0)=0, of(1)=1) via naive double recursion: `of(n-1) + of(n-2)`. That recomputes the same sub-values exponentially many times and becomes far too slow once n is in the low 40s. Rewrite of(n) to run in linear time using memoization (cache previously computed values, e.g. in a Map, so each value is computed only once), returning the exact same values. Keep the class name and the of(long) signature.
